user.title: Regions and refresh
user.description: Choose the TEC regions to follow and how often the APIs are queried.

data_description.scan_interval: Between 10 and 900 seconds. 30 seconds is a good value.

lines.title: Lines to follow
lines.description: Leave empty to follow all lines in the selected regions. You can enter a line that is not in the list.

stops.title: Stops and alerts
stops.description: Enter several stop names, one per line (e.g. Rue Loumaye, then Place St-Lambert).

data_description.stop_queries: Matching stops will be proposed in the next step. Leave empty to follow no stops.
data_description.enrich_buses: Add tripId and route information to bus entities, at the cost of extra API calls.

stop_select.title: Choose stops
stop_select.description: Select the stops to follow from the search results.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication rejected by the Letec Finder API.
